text: Horse dung!
looks very surprised.
Give it a break, you have no chance.
Damn Outlanders!
Palti!
I knew you were going to do that!
Unclean, untrue, and unworthy!  Undone I shall make you!
Rasha will see you buried.  Parts of you, anyway.
Freeze!
Death claims us all in the end.  I will be waiting for you.
Woof!
These mines are property of the grimling empire!  You have trespassed and now you die!
Uuuuhhh...arg!
slowly fades away.
floats toward the surface of the sea.
Released!  I see the way now, I shall be free.  No!  No master, please!  I am so close, I beg thee, let me rest!  Aiiiyeee!
crumbles under the duress of your assault!
Death shall enslave you, as it has me!
turns upon you with death in its eyes.
spits black blood on your armor and slithers toward you.
falls to the floor.  You are uncertain if it is truly dead this time.
releases a roaring hiss and attacks!
slithers at you with amazing speed!
falls lifelessly.
rampages toward you.
collapses in a heap of broken legs.
falls with glazed eyes, appearing slightly surprised.
A shaded creature begins to run towards you.
You're not welcome in Freeport.
lunges at you, causing small tremors with each step
crumbles to the floor in a pile of rubble
staggers, then falls hard to the ground, whatever animating force it possessed now lost.
twitches a few times, then lies motionless.
You hear a squeak as a disease-covered rodent lashes out at you.
takes a bite at you with its last breath.
Me let you win, you not as strong as you think.
attacks from nothing more than pure instinct.
Make peace with whatever powers you worship, for it is time to meet your maker.
glares at you with cold eyes, 'I will die or you will die, there are no other options. It is time to fight.'
I shall burn you endlessly.
grunts loudly and attacks!
lashes out at you!
Death will find you...as it has found me.
You shall pay for your crimes!
This one will prevent the invader from going forth.
The strengh of the Alto Roburon shall be displayed in your death!
moves sluggishly towards its next victim.
slumps to one side slowly breathing. His eyes close as his breathing slows, and ultimately stops.
Foul being, you have trifled with one of the kin and now you will die!
collapses, no longer able to support his own bulk.
This should be fun, I was starting to get bored.
rears back in one last death gasp.
forms itself into a massive wall of elemental energies and begins to move towards you.
expands its wings and draws its claws.
AARRGGHH!  Thieves!  Your blood shall run like the veins of velium in these caverns!
convulses again and again in its death throes.
unleashes numerous attacks upon you as a cloud of dust surrounds it.
begins to ooze an odd green substance.
flaps its wings rapidly and chases after you.
Broon will crush you like little pumpkin. Bwahaha!!
snaps its powerful claws at you menacingly.
swivels towards her foe as she darts inward.
stops moving.
Squire Wimbley!!  Quickly to my side!!
springs upon you, fluttering on it stubby wings.
gasps and plops to the ground.
lumbers towards you.
lumbers toward its victim.
howls as it dies.
I've promised your head as a reward to my master!
bears its fangs as it snarls and sprints toward you!
The foul scent of weaklings is near! Come meet your doom!
spirals to the ground, losing all magical ability.
sputters out a last chant before hurtling lifelessly to the ground.
paws at the ground with her cloven hooves before charging.
I do not need eyes to find your beating heart with my arrow.
This is the death to be proud of.
Death is but a stepping stone to greatness.
loses her presence in this realm.
I underestimated your power... The Alto Roburon will be prepared next time!
Brrrrrr!! Grr.. Grreetings. It is freezing out here!!
Greetings! I am Jaylin Monel, your Highkeep bank clerk. If you are here to close an account, please return your strongbox key to my assistant Kiolna and she will return any items you may have stored.
stumbles and lies prone, taking breaths in punctuated gasping snorts. Its eyes slowly close as it ceases breathing.
Squeeeeeeee!  Squeeee. . .
Defeat by mortals. . . impossible. The power of decay still beckons for you. . . someday. . .
Squeeeeeeee!  Squeeee. . .
coughs, 'Not bad, for mere amateurs. A commendable exertion on your part.'
The bringer of disease will have your filthy heart.
squawks as it crashes down in a hail of feathers, 'Neimon!'
I shall chop you down as your people chopped down the beauty of the forests!!
Your act of murder will not go unnoticed by the Unkempt Druids or nature itself!
Halt!!  Who goes there?
nocks an arrow and takes aim growling threateningly!
roars, producing a sound akin to a rumbling avalanche.
Let your death be a warning to all who dare oppose the Freeport Militia!
Die, dog!!
glares at you and lashes her tail.
Your curse will be the worst of all, a plague to rip your soul from this plane and into the next!
You worthless pack of slime, you will join your brethren in the depths of decay!
You have trifled with decay for far too long, now you will die in its recesses.
hisses as it approaches.
You are but a nuisance. Prepare to die!
How dare you tread on this holy ground?!
Intruder sighted! Be at the ready!
issues a deep rumbling laugh as his branches descend to club the life from you.
grins as a black cloud begins to swirl around his obsidian blade.
Let me show you to the spirit world!
You dare confront me?!  All attack!
trudges toward you, glittering menacingly.
's decayed corpse falls to the floor as the taint from the curse drains from her body to reveal her true visage
's corpse disintegrates into a pile of stone.
ai...yiyiyiyiyi....erp!
's corpse shudders violently as it transforms into lifeless stone.
Well, that was a job I won't soon forget! Darned magnificent boat.  Chef Chowderly over on the Queen of Thorns was kind enough to send us all some nice pies for our hard work!
We finally found a way to make some sturdy anchors. They are holding the boat in place out in the Abysmal Sea quite nicely.
beams and bows to you. 'Yep, I sure was one of the folk that pieced that mighty boat together. Sorry to see it go!
You dare challenge the champ? I will crush you like everyone else!
Xocik writhes in pain as his body falls to the floor. Your valiant efforts have resulted in the rescue of Kreshin
snarls and moves in to attack.
strides forward to deal with its enemies.
You will die a fool's death.
You have no idea what a big mistake you made. Either my fellow rogues shall find you or the Freeport Mi.. Unnnghh...
For the glory of Thurgadin!
For the defense of Kelethin!!
Your blood shall slain the stones at your feet, mortal.
This is no victory for you!  Your hate grows with every kill!
The branch has been broken and now shall be burned.  Your ashes shall join the intricate tangle of tales carried by the winds.
creates a monstrous shadow as it approaches.
What sport it shall be to hunt you. Run, while you can!
None shall flee from the might of House Legola!!
Your head shall make a fine trophy upon my mantle!!
slithers towards its prey, ready to attack.
oozes a thick smoke from its many wounds.
The might of the oceans is at my command, and with it I shall end your existence, strange one!!
You have happened upon the territory of the dervish cutthroats.  Now, you pay the price!
Submit before the sovereign might of Mayong Mistmoore!
Fabulous Four, attack!!
Start digging your grave.  The Indigo Brotherhood shall find you.
You can run, but I can hide.  Turn your back, find you have died!
Leave my lands or die!!  So says Husam the Great!!
Scrap..  Red 5 shall salvage for parts.
I am sorry friend but my duties prevent me from conversing. There are others that will gladly greet you and introduce you to the customs of our society.
Guards!!  Guards!!
blinks into being.  Its vengeful thoughts slam into your mind like a hammer.
None will desecrate the plains...
What is this atrocity?  Ancients forgive me, for I have failed in your presence.
Only now in the end do you understand why it was I who would fly here, now you die.
The blades of the Butcherblock Bandits do not discriminate!!
seems surprisingly angry with you.
shrieks in agony as it collapses to the ground dead.
shrivels up into a dead husk.
What did I ever do to you?
drops lifelessly to the ground in a bloody heap.
Another victory for the Legion of Cabilis.
Since you refuse to accept the truth I'll open the gate to the otherworld for you myself!
Not my mushrooms!  I won't ever let you hurt my mushrooms!!
Prepare to meet your doom, enemy form below!
shell cracks as it falls lifelessly to the floor.
slumps over as it dies.
hisses sharply and leaps for your throat!
falls to the ground, ichor flowing from its body.
Imagine that!!  A simple Iksar resident defeating an adventurer.  Ha!!  You should have stayed at home and become a humble merchant.  Fool!!
There had best be a bonus in this for me.
Arrrgh.
Graaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!
I have spent my life waiting for this moment!
You fool!
Take this ya lily livered landlubber!
Seru preserve us!
Yeehaw, a fight!
The Eye will repay this a thousandfold.
